# Solution Brand Assets (Output Directory)

This directory is populated by **Agent 30 (Brand & Assets Agent)** during the
solution creation workflow. It holds brand assets for the software solution being
designed — not the platform itself.

## Expected Contents (generated by agents)

- `design-tokens.json` — W3C design tokens for the solution
- `brand-guidelines.md` — Brand handbook for the solution
- `brand-assets-report.md` — Asset inventory and token status
- `assets/` — Exported PNG/SVG brand assets (logos, banners, social cards)

## Platform Brand

The **platform's own** brand assets live in `src/webapp/brand/`.
